properties.title: SiO₂ Abundance · LP GRS 20° (Prettyman et al. 2006)
properties.lri:data_use_note: SiO2 varies less across terrains than the other major oxides; useful as a normalization reference for silicate mineralogy.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Column 9 (W_SIO2, g/g) of the 20° quasi-equal-area table lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_20deg.tab (Prettyman et al. 2006) is converted to wt% (×100), then the table rows are written as WKT polygons (longitude bin width varies by latitude to preserve equal area; the two polar caps are half the latitude height of the interior bands). The polygons are rasterized onto a fine 0.1°×0.1° grid, then downsampled with mode resampling to a 10°×10° output grid (half the 20° nominal band height, so the polar caps land exactly on an output pixel edge), then written as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
properties.lri:quality_note_short: Peer-reviewed PDS product, Prettyman et al. (2006). 20° grid (~600 km).
properties.lri:quality_note: Derived by linear spectral unmixing of Lunar Prospector gamma ray spectra (Prettyman et al. 2006), calibrated against the feldspathic lunar highlands meteorite composition. Validated against independent neutron-derived macroscopic absorption cross sections (Pearson r = 0.9885) and average atomic mass (Pearson r = 0.944). This dataset passed Planetary Data System peer review.
